name: Being A Support Mage Is Harder Than You Think!
source:
Two mages-in-training struggle to get through their final examination. Will they end up graduating together, or will they end up stuck in another trap?

[From [url=https://kusoneko-dev.itch.io/support-mage-web]Itch.io[/url]]
